veranderings.voor: Hier is dit eers vrolik en word dit gespanne
veranderings.na: Hier is die stemming eers vrolik, en dit word gespanne
veranderings.rede: 'dit' could point back to the drama rather than the mood; naming 'stemming' makes the reference clear, and the AWS comma goes before 'en' joining two full clauses.

veranderings.voor: laat voel jy is op 'n plaas
veranderings.na: laat voel dat jy op 'n plaas is
veranderings.rede: In written Afrikaans the dependent clause after 'laat voel' reads better with 'dat' and the verb at the end.

veranderings.na: wat so 'n gebruik in daardie gemeenskap beteken
veranderings.rede: 'daar' is vague, since no place has been named in the sentence before it; it means the other community.

veranderings.voor: as jy dink almal in sy groep is net soos hy
veranderings.na: as jy dink dat almal in sy groep net soos hy is
veranderings.rede: In written text the subordinate clause after 'dink' reads better with 'dat' and the verb at the end.
Repeating the article keeps the two choices parallel, as the lesson does elsewhere ('n dans of 'n drama).

veranderings.voor: 'n gesig of ding van baie naby
veranderings.na: 'n gesig of 'n ding van baie naby
veranderings.rede: Repeating the article keeps the two nouns parallel and reads more naturally.
